claim: DTX3L expands the non-proteinaceous substrate repertoire to include single-stranded DNA and RNA.

claim: The N-terminal region of DTX3L contains single-stranded nucleic acid binding domains and motifs.

claim: The minimal catalytically competent fragment of DTX3L comprises the C-terminal RING and DTC domains (RD).
